name: Cardano

key_findings: Neither gate cap binds -- Regulatory Clarity Partial (65) and Security Posture Fail (70) both sit above the raw 57.15, making ADA the clearest case on the board that gate caps are ceilings, not predictions.
Set the TradFi precedent that regulatory recognition without a live spot ETF does not pass the Regulatory Clarity gate -- CME futures and Grayscale trust exist, but no spot vehicle.
On-Chain Health (48) -- annualized chain fees near $512K against a $7.5B market cap, a P/F ratio worse than SUI's previous board low.

binding_cap.short_note: Capped by Deterministic Finality FAIL -- an 8-point bind, and exactly the Prototype Only ceiling.

key_findings: Highest Economic Predictability score issued (88) -- fees are exactly calculable before submission with no bidding for inclusion, but paying more cannot accelerate inclusion at any price.
First trip of AI Principle 18 -- the November 21, 2025 event held two incompatible ledger states for ~14.5 hours while block production never stopped.
Tier margin disclosed: 54 is the exact Prototype Only ceiling; Experimental begins at 55.

watch_items: Spot ADA ETF (GADA) eligibility opened August 9, 2026 -- a live spot vehicle would flip Regulatory Clarity to Pass, though the cap does not currently bind so the published score would not move on its own.
Peras (Q2 2027 target) would lift Deterministic Finality from Fail to Partial (not Pass), moving the AI cap from 54 to 75 -- the single highest-impact pending event on either axis, worth +6.5 points.
